title: should 1
subtitle: Совет и ожидание: should, should have done, ought to

theory.text: should + глагол = «следует, стоит, лучше бы»: совет или мнение, как правильно. You should see a doctor. You shouldn't work so much. Часто с I think / I don't think / Do you think…?: I don't think you should call him. Do you think I should buy it?
should мягче, чем must / have to: You should apologise. — было бы правильно; You must apologise. — другого выхода нет.

items: Что-то не так, как ожидалось: Ben should be here by now. (его всё ещё нет, а пора бы).
Ожидаем, что так будет: She worked hard, so she should pass. It shouldn't take long.

theory.text: should have done — упрёк и сожаление о прошлом
Вместо should можно сказать ought to (с to!): You ought to rest. He ought not to drive. You ought to have asked me.

«Тебе надо было прийти» нельзя переводить как «You should come yesterday». О прошлом всегда should have + V3: You should have come yesterday. И не ставьте to после should: should go, а не «should to go».

items.ru: Тебе следует сходить к врачу.
en: You should see a doctor.
You should go to the doctor.
You ought to see a doctor.
You ought to go to the doctor.
You should go to a doctor.
You should go to the doctor's.
You ought to go to a doctor.

items.ru: Тебе не следует так много работать.
en: You shouldn't work so much.
You shouldn't work so hard.
You ought not to work so much.
You ought not to work so hard.

items.ru: Тебе не стоит верить всему, что он говорит.
en: You shouldn't believe everything he says.
You ought not to believe everything he says.

items.ru: Я думаю, тебе стоит извиниться.
en: I think you should apologise.
I think you should apologize.
I think you ought to apologise.
I think you ought to apologize.

items.ru: Я не думаю, что тебе стоит ему звонить.
en: I don't think you should call him.
I don't think you should phone him.

items.ru: Как ты думаешь, мне стоит купить эту машину?
en: Do you think I should buy this car?
Do you think I ought to buy this car?
Do you think I should buy that car?

items.ru: Нам стоит пригласить Анну?
en: Should we invite Anna?
Do you think we should invite Anna?

items.ru: Как ты думаешь, что мне делать?
en: What do you think I should do?
What do you think I ought to do?

items.ru: (другого выхода нет) Ты должен заплатить штраф.
en: You must pay the fine.
You have to pay the fine.
You've got to pay the fine.

items.ru: Бен уже должен быть здесь (а его всё нет).
en: Ben should be here by now.
Ben ought to be here by now.

items.ru: Цена неправильная, должно быть десять фунтов.
en: The price is wrong, it should be ten pounds.
The price is wrong, it should be 10 pounds.
The price is wrong because it should be ten pounds.
The price is wrong, it ought to be ten pounds.

items.ru: Она много занималась, так что должна сдать экзамен.
en: She has studied a lot, so she should pass the exam.
She's studied hard, so she should pass the exam.
She studied a lot, so she should pass the exam.
She studied hard, so she should pass the exam.

items.ru: Найти гостиницу не должно быть трудно.
en: It shouldn't be difficult to find a hotel.
It shouldn't be hard to find a hotel.
Finding a hotel shouldn't be difficult.
Finding a hotel shouldn't be hard.

items.ru: Посылка должна прийти завтра.
en: The parcel should arrive tomorrow.
The package should arrive tomorrow.
The parcel ought to arrive tomorrow.
The parcel should come tomorrow.
The package should come tomorrow.

items.ru: Тебе надо было прийти вчера, было весело.
en: You should have come yesterday, it was fun.
You should have come yesterday because it was fun.
You ought to have come yesterday, it was fun.

items.ru: Зря я выпил столько кофе.
en: I shouldn't have drunk so much coffee.
I ought not to have drunk so much coffee.

items.ru: Нам надо было забронировать столик.
en: We should have booked a table.
We should have reserved a table.
We ought to have booked a table.

items.ru: Тебе не следовало говорить ей это.
en: You shouldn't have told her that.
You shouldn't have said that to her.
You ought not to have told her that.

items.ru: Они должны были приехать час назад.
en: They should have arrived an hour ago.
They should have been here an hour ago.
They ought to have arrived an hour ago.
They should have come an hour ago.

items.ru: (а он ехал) Ему не следовало ехать так быстро.
en: He shouldn't have driven so fast.
He ought not to have driven so fast.

items.ru: Вчера вечером тебе надо было лечь спать пораньше.
en: You should have gone to bed earlier last night.
You ought to have gone to bed earlier last night.
Last night you should have gone to bed earlier.

items.ru: Тебе следует больше заниматься спортом.
en: You ought to do more exercise.
You should do more exercise.
You ought to exercise more.
You should exercise more.
You should do more sport.
You should play more sport.

items.ru: Ему не следует так поздно ложиться.
en: He shouldn't stay up so late.
He ought not to stay up so late.
He shouldn't go to bed so late.

items.ru: Тебе надо было спросить меня.
en: You ought to have asked me.
You should have asked me.
